problem_text:
A logistics firm must allocate shipping capacity across ten distinct international trade routes, each requiring passage through ten sequential maritime checkpoints. The revenue generated per ton of cargo transported on each route is specified below:
* For Route Alpha, revenue is 5.046 per ton
* For Route Beta, revenue is 17.654 per ton
* For Route Gamma, revenue is 15.87 per ton
* For Route Delta, revenue is 7.963 per ton
* For Route Epsilon, revenue is 19.195 per ton
* For Route Zeta, revenue is 19.846 per ton
* For Route Eta, revenue is 14.425 per ton
* For Route Theta, revenue is 17.539 per ton
* For Route Iota, revenue is 19.847 per ton
* For Route Kappa, revenue is 9.575 per ton

The handling time required per ton of cargo at each checkpoint is as follows:
* For Route Alpha, Checkpoint 1 needs 0.533 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 needs 0.783 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 needs 1.94 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 needs 0.733 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 needs 1.012 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 needs 1.732 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 needs 0.519 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 8 needs 1.017 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 9 needs 0.675 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 10 needs 0.955 (ton-hours)
* For Route Beta, Checkpoint 1 needs 1.93 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 needs 0.987 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 needs 0.311 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 needs 1.807 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 needs 1.743 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 needs 0.817 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 needs 0.288 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 8 needs 1.09 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 9 needs 1.354 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 10 needs 0.99 (ton-hours)
* For Route Gamma, Checkpoint 1 needs 0.321 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 needs 0.368 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 needs 1.547 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 needs 1.163 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 needs 1.369 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 needs 0.732 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 needs 0.985 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 8 needs 0.814 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 9 needs 1.379 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 10 needs 1.019 (ton-hours)
* For Route Delta, Checkpoint 1 needs 0.401 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 needs 1.422 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 needs 1.952 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 needs 0.942 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 needs 0.259 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 needs 1.175 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 needs 1.348 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 8 needs 0.838 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 9 needs 1.819 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 10 needs 1.911 (ton-hours)
* For Route Epsilon, Checkpoint 1 needs 1.047 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 needs 1.107 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 needs 0.966 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 needs 1.432 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 needs 0.306 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 needs 0.749 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 needs 1.64 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 8 needs 0.55 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 9 needs 1.169 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 10 needs 0.591 (ton-hours)
* For Route Zeta, Checkpoint 1 needs 0.407 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 needs 0.929 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 needs 1.189 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 needs 0.672 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 needs 0.812 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 needs 1.013 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 needs 1.513 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 8 needs 0.469 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 9 needs 1.259 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 10 needs 1.276 (ton-hours)
* For Route Eta, Checkpoint 1 needs 1.953 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 needs 1.29 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 needs 0.932 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 needs 1.068 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 needs 1.304 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 needs 1.158 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 needs 1.413 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 8 needs 0.729 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 9 needs 0.644 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 10 needs 1.961 (ton-hours)
* For Route Theta, Checkpoint 1 needs 1.895 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 needs 1.531 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 needs 1.967 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 needs 1.988 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 needs 0.687 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 needs 0.822 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 needs 1.858 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 8 needs 1.49 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 9 needs 0.468 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 10 needs 1.619 (ton-hours)
* For Route Iota, Checkpoint 1 needs 0.549 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 needs 0.57 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 needs 1.305 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 needs 0.575 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 needs 0.886 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 needs 0.494 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 needs 1.441 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 8 needs 1.307 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 9 needs 1.833 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 10 needs 0.372 (ton-hours)
* For Route Kappa, Checkpoint 1 needs 1.975 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 needs 0.754 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 needs 0.252 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 needs 0.829 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 needs 1.906 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 needs 0.722 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 needs 1.086 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 8 needs 0.696 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 9 needs 1.418 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 10 needs 0.869 (ton-hours)

* The cumulative handling time at Checkpoint 1 must not exceed 248.401 hours.
* The cumulative handling time at Checkpoint 2 must not exceed 227.884 hours.
* The cumulative handling time at Checkpoint 3 must not exceed 269.916 hours.
* The cumulative handling time at Checkpoint 4 must not exceed 277.62 hours.
* The cumulative handling time at Checkpoint 5 must not exceed 294.441 hours.
* The cumulative handling time at Checkpoint 6 must not exceed 158.518 hours.
* The cumulative handling time at Checkpoint 7 must not exceed 241.319 hours.
* The cumulative handling time at Checkpoint 8 must not exceed 171.127 hours.
* The cumulative handling time at Checkpoint 9 must not exceed 365.058 hours.
* The cumulative handling time at Checkpoint 10 must not exceed 213.838 hours.

Given the imperative to ensure that the total processing duration at each sequential checkpoint—Checkpoint 1 through Checkpoint 10—does not surpass its allocated operational time window, determine the optimal tonnage allocation for each trade route to maximize total revenue.
